name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: UiElement
label: UI Element
description: Select the drop-down list UI element on the web page to interact with.

name: Operation
label: Operation
description: Choose the operation to perform on the drop-down list.

selectOptions.label: Clear All Options
selectOptions.description: Clears all selected values from the drop-down list.

selectOptions.label: Select Options by Name
selectOptions.description: Selects one or more options by their display text.

selectOptions.label: Select Options by Index
selectOptions.description: Selects one or more options by their index position.

name: OptionNames
label: Option Names
description: Enter an option or a list of options to be selected. Only first used if single-select.

name: UseRegularExpressions
label: Use Regular Expressions
description: Match option names using regular expressions.

name: OptionIndices
label: Option Indices
description: Enter an index or list of indices to select in the drop-down list.

name: WaitForPageToLoad
label: Wait for Page to Load
description: Specify whether to wait for the new web page to load completely after setting the dropdown value.

name: TimeoutForWebpageToLoad
label: Timeout for Webpage to Load
description: Set the time in seconds for the page to load before the action throws an error.

name: IfAPopUpDialogAppears
label: If a Pop-Up Dialog Appears
description: Specify what to do if a pop-up dialog appears after setting the dropdown value.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

name: DialogButtonToPress
label: Dialog Button to Press
description: Enter the dialog button to press if a pop-up dialog appears.
